title: Continuous-Monitoring Recommendation
description: A Recommendation Engine output (research-harness-template#420): either an interest-matched candidate or a gap-detected research area. Every recommendation carries at least one citation (NFR5) -- enforced in code, not just by this schema. This is the shape the Editorial Gate (research-harness-template#422) reviews; it is not itself a MIF finding.

gate.description: Stamped only by packs/monitoring/continuous-monitor/scripts/editorial-gate.sh (research-harness-template#422) once a candidate has an explicit accept decision. The Output Router (research-harness-template#423) requires gate.passed === true and refuses anything else -- this is the structural enforcement that no recommendation reaches publish without passing through the gate.
